criteria.description: Canonical project identity: all sync storage, consent, routing, and delivery authority keyed by one canonical immutable project_uuid.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_identity.py; tests/sync/test_project_identity_resolver_3030.py — UUID canonicalization and rejection of braced/nil/malformed forms; slug/path/remote never select identity.
criteria.notes: Green in WP01/WP02 review gates (status.json notes).

criteria.description: ProjectSyncStore boundary: each project owns one physically separate, transactionally coherent sync store; no live operation opens another project's store.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_store.py; tests/architectural/test_project_store_boundary.py — per-UUID store resolution and architectural open-boundary ratchet.
criteria.notes: Green in WP02 review (135 focused + 62 architecture) and WP01 architectural gates.

criteria.description: One consent authority: one versioned project-owned decision is the only local grant authority; path/slug/remote/login/URL/env/target/store presence never grant.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_consent_authority.py; tests/sync/test_sync_consent_default_deny.py — sole project-store grant authority; every ambient combination stays denied.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review (27 owned + 57 incident tests).

criteria.description: Explicit offline-capable opt-in: named opt-in records an attributable project grant offline or with the kill switch disabled, then reports remote admission separately.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_consent_epochs.py; tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/test_sync_opt_in_converge.py — grant recorded while offline/kill-switch off; admission reported as pending, decision not discarded.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review gates.

criteria.description: Deny-only kill switch: SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC only suppresses egress; no value creates, copies, revives, or deletes a project grant.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_sync_consent_default_deny.py; tests/architectural/test_egress_consent_boundary.py — enabling grants nothing, disabling deletes nothing.
criteria.notes: Green in WP01/WP03 review gates.

criteria.description: Capture/egress separation: project-isolated local capture without hosted consent; selection and final transport require current consent and matching context.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_consent_epochs.py; tests/architectural/test_egress_consent_boundary.py — capture allowed pre-consent; egress fails closed without current grant.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review; architectural ratchet green through WP08.

criteria.description: Separate target-scoped admission: local consent separate from SaaS admission keyed by target identity, account/Private Teamspace, and project UUID; target changes invalidate eligibility without granting or redraining.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_target_admission_audience.py; tests/sync/test_admission_operations.py — audience-keyed admission generations; target change invalidates without redrain.
criteria.notes: Green in WP05 review (49/49 focused admission/target suite).

criteria.description: Local opt-out barrier: opt-out serializes with transport/result leases, waits for bounded outcomes, seals the epoch, and returns only when no later write or success can appear.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_transport_revocation_matrix.py — both revoke orderings across all ten sender families with durable generation assertions.
criteria.notes: Green in WP09 review (191/191 matrix tests).

criteria.description: Remote revocation truth: opt-out attempts or queues SaaS revocation and distinguishes acknowledged server revocation from locally complete but remotely pending state.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_admission_operations.py — durable revoke operation records persisted before network I/O; acknowledged vs pending revocation states distinguished.
criteria.notes: Green in WP05/WP06 review gates.

criteria.description: Sender-context integrity: every live sender consumes one immutable project context whose UUID, store, consent generation, target, and admission agree; mismatches fail before network I/O.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_sync_context.py; tests/sync/test_sender_context_convergence.py — cross-paired A/B context construction fails before selection or network I/O.
criteria.notes: Green in WP02 review; WP07 selected gate (1539 passed) covers sender convergence.

criteria.description: Daemon isolation: background discovery uses only a narrowing deny-only hint; missing/stale/unknown/pending entries re-read project-owned authority; no hint, cwd, or index grants.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_daemon_deny_hints.py; tests/sync/test_daemon_project_isolation.py — deny-only hints never grant; opted-out project A skipped while consented B continues.
criteria.notes: Green in WP08 review (194 owned/architecture tests).

criteria.description: Legacy partition migration: previewable, copy-only, idempotent migration partitions shared state by canonical UUID, preserves identities/status, verifies durably, atomically activates cutover.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_store_migration.py — WAL-aware copy-only inventory, fingerprint equality, idempotent resume, atomic cutover marker.
criteria.notes: Green in WP10 review (71 tests across 7 owned migration/cutover/command modules).

criteria.description: Legacy quarantine: missing, malformed, conflicting, and identity-less legacy rows remain in a named non-deliverable local quarantine with diagnostics and no synthetic assignment.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_store_migration.py; tests/cli/commands/test_sync_project_store_commands.py — closed quarantine reason vocabulary, no sender API, quarantine inspection command.
criteria.notes: Green in WP10 review.

criteria.description: No legacy grant promotion: refusals may derive from legacy refusals; every legacy grant lacking current explicit provenance requires re-consent.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_consent_authority.py; tests/sync/test_project_store_migration.py — migrated_refusal only for refusals; legacy grants never promoted.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 and WP10 reviews.

criteria.description: Exclusive live cutover: after migration, live capture and delivery read only project stores; shared stores are diagnostic/purge-only with no dual-read fallback.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_migration_writer_barrier.py — post-cutover live paths cannot open the shared legacy journal/ledger/queue.
criteria.notes: Green in WP10 review; both writer orderings proven.

criteria.description: Stable SaaS refusal: the CLI consumes correlated canonical project_not_admitted refusals for event, LocalCommit, body, and history/preflight writes and parks affected work without transient retry.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_saas_refusal_parking.py; tests/sync/test_saas_admission_compatibility.py — correlated project_not_admitted parks terminally, no transient retry.
criteria.notes: Green in WP05 focused suite; live stale-generation race rerun (tests/integration/test_project_sync_stale_generation.py) is WP11 evidence and remains pending.

criteria.description: Structural diagnostics: diagnostics report store identity, local decision, kill-switch state, target readiness, admission state, pending revocation, migration/quarantine state, and blocking reason without secrets or payloads.
criteria.evidence: tests/cli/commands/test_sync_project_store_commands.py — project-store status/doctor/quarantine diagnostics without opening retired stores.
criteria.notes: Green in WP10 review.

criteria.description: Predecessor preservation: #3030 consent-bearing batches, final transmit rechecks, SQL identity predicates, purge, and terminal-refusal controls remain independent defense in depth.
criteria.evidence: tests/delivery/test_consented_batch_3030.py and the 22-surface #3030 consent regression matrix (350 passed, 2 xfailed under -W error).
criteria.notes: Green in WP01 cycle-5/6 review gates.

criteria.description: Cross-repository proof split: a conforming six-project CLI run proves only A appears in request bytes and owns client-side terminal-parking evidence; SaaS evidence owns bypass refusal and zero server effects.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/test_project_sync_six_project.py (planned WP11 T050) — exact sanitized CLI bytes contain only admitted project A.
criteria.notes: WP11-evidence-dependent: six-project run and SaaS-owned counterpart attestation are not yet present in this checkout.

criteria.description: Incident evidence separation: core #3262 closure evidence does not claim SaaS #585 is closed; historical disposition remains a separate Human-in-Charge gate.
criteria.evidence: kitty-specs/per-project-sync-consent-ledgers-01KZKMQZ/issue-matrix.json — #3262 core-owned rows separated from #585 companion-dependency; historical disposition recorded as out of program scope per operator (2026-08-13).
criteria.notes: Issue-matrix separation is recorded; final verification is bound to the WP11 manifest and operator acceptance.

criteria.description: Consent epochs: every captured row carries an epoch; opt-in starts eligibility at the current tail; opt-out seals without deleting; re-opt-in never auto-eligibilizes older epochs.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_consent_epochs.py — tail-inclusive sealing, fresh eligible epoch on opt-in, no resurrection on re-opt-in.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review.

criteria.description: Explicit history action: sealed rows egress only through a separate previewed explicit history action under current consent, target, and admission.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_history_disclosure.py; tests/cli/commands/test_sync_project_store_commands.py — immutable preview cohort/hash, explicit confirmation identity, ordinary selection cannot mint or consume it.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 and WP10 reviews.

criteria.description: Legacy writer retirement: checkout-only/default inheritance, consent-index backfill, and other legacy grant writers removed or fail non-zero with migration guidance and create no grant.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_consent_authority.py; tests/cli/commands/test_sync_project_store_commands.py — retired shared `sync migrate` refuses; legacy grant writers create no grant.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 (retired legacy writers) and WP10 (retired shared migrate refusal) reviews.

criteria.description: Old-process cutover safety: migration quiesces recognized daemons through a protocol/restart handshake; post-cutover legacy writes are diagnosed non-deliverable residue, never read live.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_daemon_cutover_protocol.py — versioned authenticated loopback quiesce/restart handshake failing closed on identity drift; post_cutover_residue diagnosis.
criteria.notes: Green in WP10 review.

criteria.description: Truthful in-flight outcomes: a genuine result from a transport started before opt-out is recorded under its original generation before opt-out returns; never discarded or used to revive eligibility.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_transport_orphan_settlement.py; tests/sync/test_transport_revocation_matrix.py — started-before-opt-out outcomes settle truthfully under the old generation; late success cannot create eligibility.
criteria.notes: Green in WP06 and WP09 reviews.

criteria.description: Connection-owned unit of work: one ProjectSyncStore unit-of-work owns live SQLite connections and transaction boundaries; component-local connections/commits prohibited.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_store_transactions.py — opaque result facade, transaction-control SQL rejected through repository ports, atomic fault bundles.
criteria.notes: Green in WP02 cycle-2 review.

criteria.description: Durable admission operations: admit/revoke/readmit persist an operation record before network I/O with immutable key, action, expected generation, target tuple, and original server result.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_admission_operations.py — operation records persisted pre-I/O; uncertain retries reuse the same key.
criteria.notes: Green in WP05 review.

criteria.description: Explicit history disclosure capability: binds immutable preview cohort/hash/count, source epochs, confirmation identity, current generations, idempotency key, and terminal results.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_history_disclosure.py — persisted capability required before WP07 transport; ordinary selection cannot mint or consume it.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review; WP10 wired the CLI confirmation path.

criteria.description: Migration-generation writer barrier: ProjectSyncStore owns one layout-generation authority; every current-version writer acquires/checks it immediately before insert and retries or redirects safely.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_migration_writer_barrier.py — both writer orderings for every current writer class; exactly-once redirect; no private layout inference.
criteria.notes: Green in WP02 (authority) and WP10 (cutover orderings) reviews.

criteria.description: Crash-aware transport attempts: each transport persists its attempt before network I/O, uses bounded idempotency/reconciliation, recovers after process death without inventing success or resending.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_transport_crash_matrix.py; tests/sync/test_transport_attempt_recovery.py — real subprocess kills at five windows x ten families; no resend on uncertainty; opt-out terminalizes orphans.
criteria.notes: Green in WP06 and WP09 reviews (191/191 matrix).

criteria.description: Stable admission audience: normalized server origin and persisted account/Private-Teamspace binding; a generation is reusable only when audience and project UUID match exactly.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_target_admission_audience.py — audience mismatch invalidates generation reuse.
criteria.notes: Green in WP05 review.

criteria.description: Monotonic capture sequence: each capture receives a monotonic store-local sequence in the same transaction as epoch assignment; eligibility begins strictly after the recorded tail.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_consent_epochs.py — capture-vs-opt-in in both transaction orderings; rows at/below the tail stay sealed.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review.

criteria.description: Candidate contract attestation: acceptance consumes an explicitly selected SaaS candidate checkout/commit, verifies the canonical contract digest, and records path/ref/digest in evidence; no ambient sibling authority.
criteria.evidence: scripts/evidence/build_project_sync_consent_manifest.py + tests/evidence/test_project_sync_consent_manifest.py (planned WP11 T049) — current candidate: spec-kitty-saas 4e15aa5cf263d857f6e10541d3f19cc4c993e5c5, contracts/cli-saas-current-api.yaml sha256 57e66b0f3f234c663eb00dffbe04cbcbed3375d8f283875f42e6ff5481022b7b.
criteria.notes: WP11-evidence-dependent: the attestation script/test are not yet present in this checkout; digest above computed from the explicit candidate checkout, not an ambient sibling.

criteria.description: Immutable closure evidence: schema-versioned manifest binding commits, contract digest, test/mutant results, raw benchmark artifacts, checksums, and retention coordinates; issue-matrix rows name owning WPs.
criteria.evidence: build/evidence/project-sync-consent/<core-commit>/manifest.json via scripts/evidence/build_project_sync_consent_manifest.py, retained >=90 days by .github/workflows/project-sync-consent-evidence.yml (planned WP11 T054).

criteria.description: Physical isolation proof: store-open instrumentation observes zero cross-project opens, locks, reads, writes, acknowledgements, schema operations, or deletes across the A/B matrix.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_daemon_project_isolation.py; tests/sync/test_transport_revocation_matrix.py — ProjectSyncStore open-tracking proves project-B physical isolation across the matrix.
criteria.notes: Green in WP08/WP09 reviews; the WP11 cross-platform extension (tests/sync/test_project_store_cross_platform.py) remains pending under NFR-005.

criteria.description: Migration fidelity: before/after IDs, targets, states, attempts, timestamps, and content hashes match exactly; interruption at every durable phase adds zero duplicates/redeliveries.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_store_migration.py — pre/post fingerprint equality, idempotent resume after injected interruption, sources unchanged.
criteria.notes: Green in WP10 review.

criteria.description: Revocation race proof: per sender, real transport/ledger tests cover pause-before-start and start-before-opt-out with zero post-return write/success.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_transport_revocation_matrix.py — both orderings for all ten sender families with exact-byte closed wire envelopes.
criteria.notes: Green in WP09 review (191/191).

criteria.description: Mutation strength: mutants restoring a shared store, granting from environment/repo defaults, removing the final consent check, or cross-pairing context each make named acceptance tests fail.

criteria.notes: WP11-evidence-dependent: WP09 reviewer mutants (13 forgery oracles) are green, but the named acceptance mutant set and its manifest record are not yet produced.

criteria.description: Cross-platform identity: deterministic ASCII-safe store paths pass the identity matrix on Linux, macOS, and Windows, including accented and non-ASCII display names.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_project_store_cross_platform.py (planned WP11 T052); today only macOS/Windows path slices exist (tests/sync/test_daemon_windows_paths.py).
criteria.notes: WP11-evidence-dependent: the cross-platform matrix module is not yet present in this checkout.

criteria.evidence: tests/perf/test_project_discovery_benchmark.py + scripts/benchmarks/bench_project_discovery.py (planned WP11 T053) with raw JSON samples and runtime metadata in the evidence bundle.

criteria.description: Credential and payload safety: diagnostics, migration reports, logs, fixtures, and errors expose zero access tokens and zero raw event bodies outside their owning project store.
criteria.evidence: Sanitization checks in the WP11 evidence bundle (manifest sanitized-identity persistence, T049) plus diagnostics assertions in tests/cli/commands/test_sync_project_store_commands.py.
criteria.notes: WP11-evidence-dependent: a dedicated no-secrets sweep over the closure evidence bundle has not yet run; diagnostics-level checks alone do not discharge this NFR.

criteria.description: No implicit consent: repo slug, checkout path, remote URL, login, configured host, target readiness, daemon startup, or environment variables never create consent.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_sync_consent_default_deny.py; tests/sync/test_project_consent_authority.py — every ambient combination leaves the project denied.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review.

criteria.evidence: tests/contract/test_project_sync_admission_contract.py (green, WP05) + pinned contract harness against attested candidate (tests/contract/test_cli_saas_sync_contract.py, planned WP11).

criteria.evidence: tests/architectural/test_tracker_egress_guards_3108.py — Channel 2 cannot grant or substitute for project sync consent.
criteria.notes: Green in WP01/WP07 review gates; #3108/#3135 tracked as deferred-with-followup in issue-matrix.json.

criteria.description: Historical events excluded: the mission does not inspect, delete, move, reassign, or decide the disposition of the 1,322 historical SaaS events.

criteria.notes: Operator-owned: verified by absence of any historical-cohort mutation in program evidence; final check rides the WP11 manifest.

criteria.evidence: WP05/WP10 review notes in status.json attest no retired-host.example mutation; hosted mutation confined to local/test SaaS.
criteria.notes: Operator-owned: per-WP attestations exist; program-level confirmation belongs to the WP11 evidence bundle and operator acceptance.

criteria.description: No silent compatibility fallback: old shared stores and legacy consent records support diagnosis, explicit migration, or purge only; they never silently re-enter live delivery.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_migration_writer_barrier.py; tests/sync/test_project_store_migration.py — post-cutover residue diagnosed, never dual-read into delivery.
criteria.notes: Green in WP10 review.

criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_consent_epochs.py — opt-out seals rather than deletes; explicit purge remains a separate workflow.
criteria.notes: Green in WP03 review.

criteria.description: Admission target identity: an opaque server generation is valid only for the exact resolved server, authenticated account/canonical Private Teamspace, and project UUID that produced it.
criteria.evidence: tests/sync/test_target_admission_audience.py — generation reuse refused on any audience or UUID mismatch.
